section.catchline: Tax on nonresident individual -- Calculation -- Exemption.
section.subsection:
Except as provided in Subsection (2), a tax is imposed on a nonresident individual in an amount equal to the product of the:
nonresident individual's state taxable income; and percentage listed in Subsection 59-10-104(2).

This section does not apply to a nonresident individual:
exempt from taxation under Section 59-10-104.1; or whose only state source income is wages that are excluded in accordance with Section 59-10-117.5.
